origin:
JOTA Sport's journey began in the early 2000s, conceived by a group of motorsport enthusiasts with a shared passion for endurance racing. Sam Hignett, a former racer himself, spearheaded the project, envisioning a team that could punch above its weight in the fiercely competitive world of sports car racing. Initial funding came from a combination of private investment and small sponsorships, enabling them to acquire a relatively modest base of operations and a used Courage C65 chassis. Early races were a trial by fire, with mechanical gremlins and driver errors aplenty, but the team's unwavering dedication and willingness to learn from their mistakes gradually led to improved performances and a growing reputation within the paddock.

The team's breakthrough moment came in 2014, securing a hard-fought victory in the LMP2 class at the 24 Hours of Le Mans. This triumph catapulted JOTA Sport into the limelight, proving that their underdog spirit and meticulous preparation could overcome even the most formidable opposition. The win validated Hignett's vision and attracted more substantial backing, allowing JOTA to invest in better equipment and attract talented drivers and engineers. This marked the beginning of a new era for the team, transforming them from a plucky privateer outfit into a serious contender on the international stage.
philosophy: JOTA Sport operates under a philosophy of continuous improvement and unwavering teamwork. They prioritize extracting maximum performance from their available resources, focusing on meticulous preparation, data analysis, and driver development. The team fosters a collaborative environment where every member's contribution is valued, promoting open communication and shared responsibility. They approach car development with a pragmatic and data-driven mindset, prioritizing reliability and drivability over outright pace, believing that consistency is key to success in endurance racing.
achievements: LMP2 Class Victory at the 24 Hours of Le Mans (2014)
Multiple podium finishes in the FIA World Endurance Championship

teamPrincipal.name: Sam Hignett
teamPrincipal.background: Sam Hignett is a former racing driver who transitioned into team management, bringing a wealth of experience and a deep understanding of the sport. His leadership style is characterized by a hands-on approach, fostering a strong sense of camaraderie within the team.

keyFigures.name: Simon Elliott
keyFigures.description: Simon Elliott is the mastermind behind JOTA Sport's technical strategy, responsible for optimizing car setup and performance. He is known for his meticulous attention to detail and his ability to extract the most from the team's equipment.

headquarters: JOTA Sport operates from a small but well-equipped workshop in Edenbridge, Kent. Their facilities are relatively basic, focusing on practical functionality rather than lavish amenities.
fanBase: JOTA Sport has cultivated a loyal fanbase drawn to their underdog story and consistent overperformance. Their supporters appreciate the team's no-nonsense approach and their unwavering commitment to delivering results, regardless of the odds. They are seen as the team that proves that money isn't everything.
